name: State Machine cat
description: A text-based state-machine diagram generator with a compact DSL and support for compound states, entry and exit actions, transitions, and SCXML import and export.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 使用简洁的DSL描述状态、迁移、事件、条件和动作，并自动生成状态机图。复合状态、entry/exit 动作以及内部和外部迁移，同时支持SCXML的导入和导出。
classificationNotes: Diagram rendering and SCXML transformation are not counted as target-language code generation.
